changes.en: About the same fat: 80 to 85 % against about 80 % in butter, with a similar rest. The book asks for great care when soft tub margarine takes the place of solid margarine.
changes.de: Etwa gleich viel Fett: 80 bis 85 % gegenüber etwa 80 % in Butter, der Rest ist ähnlich. Das Buch mahnt zu großer Sorgfalt, wenn weiche Streichmargarine feste Margarine ersetzt.

sources.title: Understanding Ingredients for the Canadian Baker (BC Cook Articulation Committee, BCcampus)
sources.place: chapter 3.3 Major Fats and Oils Used in Bakeries, section Margarine
sources.sentence: Margarine has a fat content ranging from 80% to 85%, with the balance pretty much the same as butter.

sources.title: Understanding Ingredients for the Canadian Baker (BC Cook Articulation Committee, BCcampus)
sources.place: chapter 3.3 Major Fats and Oils Used in Bakeries, section Margarine
sources.sentence: Great care must be taken when attempting to substitute spreadable margarine for solid margarine in recipes.

sources.title: McGee on Food and Cooking (Harold McGee), Hodder & Stoughton 2004
sources.place: chapter Milk and Dairy Products, Kinds of Margarine and Related Spreads, p. 38
sources.sentence: Tub margarine is substantially less saturated and easily spreadable even at 40°F/5°C, but too soft to cream or to use in layered pastries.
